title: Comes in the wrong packaging
text: Comes in the wrong packaging. As I am sure you can see from all the product photos customers have posted, the product is fine, but it come in the wrong packaging which says it's a magnet.  So, I'm thinking hey, maybe this is a magnet also so you can attach it to stuff.  I actually walked around my office trying to get it to stick to something.  Also, it doesn't hold many toothpick, and it's a bit long for what it's holding.  It's fine, it's not horrible.  I'm not returning it, but I certainly wouldn't buy it again..
